name: researchzy-social
description: Social-science methods with your agent: questionnaires with a recorded wording review and a response-quality audit, scale reliability and validity, mediation and moderation with bootstrap intervals, qualitative coding with quotes checked against the transcripts, and text turned into validated variables. No account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Surveys, scales, path models, qualitative coding and text as data.
interface.longDescription: Design a questionnaire with an item table that records each scale's source and licence, a wording review and exclusion rules written before fielding, then audit the responses: straight-lining on the raw values, speed, attention items, duplicates and missing data, counted under your rules. Check a scale's reliability and validity from the data: item analysis, alpha and omega, parallel analysis, CFA with convergence and SRMR, CR, AVE and HTMT, and invariance. Estimate mediation, moderation and moderated mediation with bootstrap intervals, Johnson-Neyman regions and a model registered first. Code interviews with every quote checked at its place in the transcript and blind calibration of agreement, and turn text into variables with sealed rounds, a frozen labelling instruction and corrected class shares. Every cut-off is a convention you choose and every number in your text is checked.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the reliability and validity of my questionnaire scales from this data file.
